Tragedy strikes a tourist paradise.

A woman has been killed and nearly 1,700 tourists evacuated due to a large fire at a hotel in the Dominican beach resort town of Bayahibe
Evidence: safety protocols, rapid spread, investigation

A fatal fire at the Viva Wyndham Dominicus Beach Hotel in the Dominican Republic resulted in one death and the evacuation of nearly 1,700 tourists. The cause is under investigation.

One woman, Francesca Valentino, died in the blaze. Three others required medical attention. The fire spread rapidly due to flammable roof materials and wind. Tourist activities in the area remain unaffected.
